content.divergence_summary: Both branches encountered the same anchor on 2026-05-11: A hollow log wedged over the brook hums when the current hits it; minnows gather under it and the bank sounds alive in a new way. Main YY answered through immediate practical movement; feather-branch YY also carried the sign to Mira ledger.
content.branch_a_path: YY found the humming log at the brook, listened until the minnows gathered, and marked the place as a food-sound worth remembering.
content.branch_b_path: YY read the hum to Mira as a water-sound that gathered small life and earned the first non-sky entry in the ledger.
key_differences: Main keeps the encounter mostly private and body-first.
The feather branch makes the encounter legible through Mira without making it a performance.
Food stores and attention rise at different rates because the ledger route costs time.
shared_elements: A hollow log wedged over the brook hums when the current hits it; minnows gather under it and the bank sounds alive in a new way.
Both branches keep the event physical and local.
Neither branch creates a new fork; the day deepens existing patterns.
